test_title: PYST 40: SSC CPO - English Comprehension (Held on 9 Nov 2022 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

Call it a day

options.text: Call it as a bad day
Call it as a good and productive day

solution:
The correct answer is** Stop working on something**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Call it a day** means to stop working, either at one's job or on a particular task, for the rest of the day

 
 
• Eg. *This package is the last one. Once we get this shipped, we can call it a day.*
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Let's see the meaning of some other idioms:

 
• Call it a night - To stop working, either at one's job or on a particular task, for the rest of the night.
 
• Call it a wash - To acknowledge or consider a situation or exchange as being equal or equitable, as regarding debt, status, ability, a contest, etc.
